title: Restriction of an integer multiplicity current to a measurable part of its carrier: integrality and mass additivity
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, let the IMRep R = (C, θ, ξ) in U represent T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with H^n(A ∖ C) = 0, and let T₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(U) satisfy T₁(ω) = ∫_A ⟨ω, ξ⟩ dH^n for all ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U). Then T₁ and T − T₁ are integer multiplicity, M_W(T₁) + M_W(T − T₁) = M_W(T) for every open W, and M_W(T − T₁) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A : Set (Euclid P)) (T T₁ : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → MeasurableSet A → μHE[n] (A \ R.carrier) = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T₁ ω = ∫ x in A, R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (T - T₁) ∧ (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T₁.massOn W + (T - T₁).massOn W = T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → (T - T₁).massOn W ≠ ∞
